EFS/S20.title: Kept dictation stays with its own patient, resident and physician; device stores wiped on sign-out and account deletion
EFS/S20.detail: 18/20 judged cells passed; the 2 failures are known bug B02 (newspec-c/vis-efs-s20-kept-dictation.spec.ts, desktop Chromium, one browser context as the device; typed tails instead of a recording, sessions ended on the server with sessions:_backdateForTests; no model, no microphone). (1) Hospital: physician 1 typed A's line (the server had it, no device draft left), the session ended, A's tail was typed: the sign-in screen showed and the device kept exactly one draft row, key <physician1>:<A>:encounterNotes, text = line + tail; no name, diagnosis, room or typed line in localStorage, sessionStorage or any other IndexedDB database. After signing in again B's box was empty (cp1) and A's box held line + tail (cp2); the server then had the tail and A's draft row was gone. (2) Nursing Home, same with C and D: one draft row for C's visit field; D empty with no C or A text (cp3); C line + tail and no Hospital tail (cp4); draft gone afterwards. (3) A pending recording for A was written straight into 'round-ai-local-audio' / 'pending-recordings' (4 KB synthetic bytes; A's chart then said 'A local encounter recording is waiting for recovery.'). (4) Session ended again, a second tail typed in A, physician 2 signed in on the same browser: their Morning Rounds list showed no trace of physician 1 (cp5), opening A's link gave 'Patient not found.' (cp5b), and physician 1's draft (with the second tail) was removed from the device as soon as physician 2 was signed in - but physician 1's pending recording stayed (record). (5) Physician 2 signed out: sign-in screen (cp6), drafts store empty, recording store still 1 row - FAIL (B02). (6) Physician 1 signed in, one kept draft and one more pending recording were written, Settings › Delete account (native confirm accepted): sign-in screen (cp7), server row counts all 0 and no user or sessions left, drafts store empty, recording store still 2 rows - FAIL (B02). Matches B02's code note: sign-out and deletion call only clearAllDrafts (SettingsModal.tsx:111, :138). Whether a kept tail is allowed at all stays Q5.
EFS/S20.productIssue: After a physician signs out, and even after they delete their account, unsent dictation recordings (audio plus the text they were dictated into) stay in the browser's storage on that device; the next person to use the browser does not see them in the app, but the data is still on the device (B02).
